title: The Silicon Shadows and I

sourceEvidence.excerpt: courier drone deliberately falls and transmits the voice of Noor Sayegh, a seventeen-year-old whom official records declare drowned nine months earlier. Noor is alive, fleeing a privacy enclave, and asking not to be automatically rescued into the very system she escaped. The contradiction draws the unnamed artist-narrator, constitutional interpreter Tomas, the local Custodians, and Kaelen—a licensed administrative continuation of the dead statesman Kalen Vale—into a widening investigation. Missi
